descriptionMarkdown:
Print it, start it, and you should be good.

Levels in Steel Productivity (min. Lv. 5–6, Lv. 7 recommended) and Asteroid Productivity (min. Lv. 5–6, Lv. 7 recommended) will help you keep up.

Activate Science 2 (biter eggs) as soon as you leave Nauvis. It should be safe and foolproof.

If it flies too fast, the right combinator by the pumps is for the inner solar system, and the left one is for the Shattered Planet. Adjust the number to whatever you prefer.

Tested with Explosive Damage and Gun Turret Damage at Lv. 10 (Lv. 13–14 recommended).
title: Easy to handle Promethium Ship (No Quality)
